data.name: Urson
data.gender_notes: Urson is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old High German 'ursa' meaning bear and 'son', the name Urson can be translated as 'strong, son of a bear'. In medieval Europe, bears were considered sacred animals, and their cubs were believed to possess great strength and courage. This name carries a powerful and noble connotation, making it an excellent choice for a baby boy.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and courage, derived from the name of a bear.
data.etymology: Urson belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Son of a bear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Urson total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
